title: Knit Together with Care
intro: This month, hidden from every eye but God's, you are being woven. Nothing about this work is hurried and nothing about it is careless. We speak over every unseen thread: made with care, made with love, made whole.

keyScripture.text: For you created my inmost being; you knit me together in my mother's womb. I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

weeks.title: Knit with Care
weeks.declaration: Little one, you are being knit together by hands that never slip. Every thread is deliberate, every stitch is love. This week we declare wholeness over everything being formed in you.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, You are working in the unseen, and we trust the work. Where our minds run ahead into worry, bring them back to Your steady hands. Amen.

weeks.title: Formed in the Secret Place
weeks.declaration: Little one, the secret place is not a hidden place to God. He sees every part of you clearly and He calls it good. We declare that what is forming in secret will one day stand in strength.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, thank You that nothing about our child is hidden from You. Give us patience for what we cannot see, and quiet confidence in what You are doing. Amen.

weeks.title: Wonderfully Made
weeks.declaration: Little one, wonder is the right word for you. You are not ordinary and you were never meant to be. We declare that you will live at home in the body and the mind God is giving you.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, You do wonderful work. Teach us to praise before we can see, and to speak wonder over this child instead of worry. Amen.

weeks.title: Held Together
weeks.declaration: Little one, in Christ all things hold together, and that includes you. Every part of you is being sustained by the One who holds galaxies. We declare that you are held.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, You hold what we cannot. Take the weight we were never meant to carry, and let us rest this week in Your keeping. Amen.

days.title: Knit Together
days.declaration: Little one, you are being knit together stitch by stitch by a God who is never rushed. Nothing about you is being left to chance. We declare careful, complete, beautiful work over you.

scripture.text: You knit me together in my mother's womb.

days.title: Inmost Being
days.declaration: Little one, God is forming not just your body but your inmost being. Your spirit is His work too. We declare a heart that will know Him easily and love Him early.

scripture.text: For you created my inmost being.

days.title: The Secret Place
days.declaration: Little one, you are in the secret place, and the secret place is safe. What is hidden from us is fully seen by Him. We declare peace over everything we cannot yet see.

scripture.text: When I was made in the secret place.

days.title: Woven
days.declaration: Little one, you are being woven together with skill and delight. There is an artistry to you. We declare that you will carry the mark of the Maker all your life.

scripture.text: When I was woven together in the depths of the earth.

days.title: Wonderful Works
days.declaration: Little one, God's works are wonderful, and you are one of His works. We declare today that you will never have to argue for your own value; it is already settled.

scripture.text: Your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

days.title: Every Part Whole
days.declaration: Little one, we speak wholeness over every part of you being formed today. Complete, healthy, strong, and lacking nothing. We declare it in faith and we leave it in God's hands.

scripture.text: May your whole spirit, soul and body be kept blameless.

days.title: Unhurried
days.declaration: Little one, God is not in a hurry with you, and neither are we. Growth has its own time and we will not rush it. We declare patience over this house.

scripture.text: He has made everything beautiful in its time.

days.title: Fearless Over You
days.declaration: Little one, fear does not get to speak over you today. Where anxiety rises, love answers louder. We declare a fear-free atmosphere around your growing.
days.partner: Little one, I will not let fear speak over you. Where worry rises in me, I will answer it with love. This is a fear-free house for you to grow in.

scripture.text: Perfect love drives out fear.

days.title: Strength in the Small
days.declaration: Little one, you are small and you are strong, and both are true at once. God does mighty things in tiny beginnings. We declare strength into what looks fragile.

scripture.text: My power is made perfect in weakness.

days.title: Life in the Blood
days.declaration: Little one, life is flowing through you today. We declare health and vitality into every part of you, and we thank God for the quiet miracle of your growing.

scripture.text: For the life of a creature is in the blood.

days.title: Sustained
days.declaration: Little one, you are being sustained every second by a God who never looks away. You do not have to hold yourself together. We declare that He is your keeping.

scripture.text: Sustaining all things by his powerful word.

days.title: Good Work Begun
days.declaration: Little one, God finishes what He begins. He began you, and He will complete you. We declare confidence over your whole life today.

scripture.text: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

days.title: Covered
days.declaration: Little one, you are covered. Not exposed, not vulnerable to whatever comes, but covered by the shadow of the Almighty. We declare shelter over you.

scripture.text: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

days.title: Rest for the Weary
days.declaration: Little one, today we receive rest on your behalf and on ours. Tiredness is not failure. We declare that you are growing in a home that knows how to rest.

scripture.text: Come to me, all you who are weary, and I will give you rest.

days.title: Seen
days.declaration: Little one, you are seen by the God who sees. Nothing about you is too small for His attention. We declare that you will never feel invisible.

scripture.text: You are the God who sees me.

days.title: Named Before Known
days.declaration: Little one, God knew you before we did and loved you first. We are joining a love that was already in progress. We declare that you are deeply, permanently loved.

scripture.text: Before I was born the Lord called me.

days.title: Peace in the Waiting
days.declaration: Little one, waiting is not wasted time. God is working in the wait. We declare peace over every day we do not yet have answers for.

scripture.text: Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength.

days.title: Fearfully Made
days.declaration: Little one, you are fearfully made, which means made with awe. We declare that you will grow up amazed at God rather than anxious about yourself.

scripture.text: I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

days.title: A Steady Heart
days.declaration: Little one, we declare a steady heart over you, one that will not be easily shaken. May courage be natural to you and peace be your default.

scripture.text: Their heart is steadfast, trusting in the Lord.

days.title: Held Together
days.declaration: Little one, in Him all things hold together, and so do you. We declare that every system, every part, every detail of you is held by Christ today.

scripture.text: In him all things hold together.

days.title: Grace Upon Grace
days.declaration: Little one, there is more than enough grace for you and more than enough for us. We declare an abundance over your life, never a scarcity.

scripture.text: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.

days.title: The Breath of Life
days.declaration: Little one, the same God who breathed life into the first human is breathing life into you. We declare full life, strong life, God-given life over you.

scripture.text: The Spirit of God has made me; the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

days.title: Kindness Around You
days.declaration: Little one, we are building kindness around you before you arrive. May gentleness be the first language you hear. We declare a kind home over your growing.

scripture.text: Be kind and compassionate to one another.

days.title: No Comparison
days.declaration: Little one, you are not a copy of anyone. God made you singular on purpose. We declare freedom from comparison over your entire life, starting now.

scripture.text: Each one should test their own actions... without comparing themselves to someone else.

days.title: Guarded
days.declaration: Little one, God guards what belongs to Him, and you belong to Him. We declare protection over you today, in the seen and in the unseen.

scripture.text: The Lord will keep you from all harm.

days.title: Delight
days.declaration: Little one, God delights in you. Not one day when you achieve something, but now, exactly as you are. We declare that delight will be the soundtrack of your life.
days.partner: Little one, I delight in you already. Not for anything you will do, but simply because you are. That is how I want you to hear my voice all your life.

scripture.text: He will take great delight in you.

days.title: Growing Quietly
days.declaration: Little one, you are growing quietly and that is exactly right. Not everything real is loud. We declare that you will be secure without needing to be seen.

scripture.text: The seed sprouts and grows, though he does not know how.

days.title: Kept
days.declaration: Little one, we end this month the way we began it: you are held. Woven, watched over, and kept. We declare that the hands forming you will never let you go.

scripture.text: I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
